3 import crypto from 'node:crypto';
4 
5 export const CONTRACT_VERSION = 1;
6 import { resolveTier } from './governor.mjs';
7 import { loopThresholds } from './round.mjs';
8 import { loadPreregistration } from './preregistration.mjs';
9 
10 /**
11  * Input classification table tagging each governor input 'known-by-Stage-1' 
12  * vs 'emergent-during-rounds'. The initial budget is locked on Stage-1-known inputs only.
13  */
14 export const INPUT_CLASSIFICATION = Object.freeze({
15   stakesTier: 'known-by-Stage-1',
16   maxRounds: 'known-by-Stage-1',
17   N: 'known-by-Stage-1',
18   K: 'known-by-Stage-1',
19   M: 'known-by-Stage-1',
20   // Anything discovered mid-run goes here, and will not affect the Stage-1 lock
21   emergentConflict: 'emergent-during-rounds',
22   emergentItem: 'emergent-during-rounds'
23 });
24 
25 /**
26  * Filter inputs to only include those known by Stage-1.
27  */
28 function extractStage1Inputs(inputs) {
29   const stage1 = {};
30   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(inputs || {})) {
31     if (INPUT_CLASSIFICATION[k] === 'known-by-Stage-1') {
32       stage1[k] = v;
33     }
34   }
35   return stage1;
36 }
37 
38 /**
39  * Serialize an object canonically (stable key order, no whitespace variation).
40  */
41 export function canonicalSerialize(obj) {
42   if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
43     return JSON.stringify(obj);
44   }
45   if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
46     return `[${obj.map(canonicalSerialize).join(',')}]`;
47   }
48   const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
49   let result = '{';
50   for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
51     const k = keys[i];
52     if (i > 0) result += ',';
53     result += JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + canonicalSerialize(obj[k]);
54   }
55   result += '}';
56   return result;
57 }
58 
59 /**
60  * Hash a canonical serialization of the locked OUTPUT artifact.
61  */
62 export function hashLockedOutput(output) {
63   const serialized = canonicalSerialize(output);
64   return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(serialized).digest('hex');
65 }
66 
67 /**
68  * The Formal Stakes Governor.
69  * Exposes a stable typed output contract covering round budget, bounds, and thresholds.
70  */
71 function preregisteredN() {
72   try { return loadPreregistration().N; } catch { return 1; }
73 }
74 
75 export function lockGovernorOutput(inputs) {
76   // Only Stage-1-known inputs determine the initial lock
77   const stage1Inputs = extractStage1Inputs(inputs);
78   
79   const inputsHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalSerialize(stage1Inputs)).digest('hex');
80   
81   const roundBudget = typeof stage1Inputs.maxRounds === 'number' ? stage1Inputs.maxRounds : 8;
82   const thresholds = {
83     // The fallback READS the pre-registration (it used to hard-code 3 while
84     // preregistration.json said 2 — two sources of truth, the doctor/builder
85     // drift class; the 2026-08-15 elegance run converged under a threshold
86     // nobody had committed). N re-locked to 1 by John 2026-08-16 (rule 5).
87     N: typeof stage1Inputs.N === 'number' ? stage1Inputs.N : preregisteredN(),
88     K: typeof stage1Inputs.K === 'number' ? stage1Inputs.K : 4,
89     M: typeof stage1Inputs.M === 'number' ? stage1Inputs.M : 2,
90   };
91   const bounds = {
92     // placeholders for future bounds run-rounds might read
93   };
94   
95   return {
96     roundBudget,
97     bounds,
98     thresholds,
99     provenance: {
100       inputsHash,
101       contractVersion: CONTRACT_VERSION
102     }
103   };
104 }
105 
106 /**
107  * Derive the FULL governor contract from raw run inputs: the locked Stage-1 output
108  * plus the resolved stakes tier. Accepts the flat Stage-1 shape (stakesTier/N/K/M/
109  * maxRounds) and the run/legacy shapes — `preregThresholds: {N,K,M}` folds into the
110  * flat thresholds before the lock, and `stakes` (a tier string OR a declared stakes
111  * vector) resolves through the Wave-4 adjudicator (I6 floor applied). An absent
112  * stakes declaration adjudicates to `low` (never a silent upgrade).
113  */
114 export function deriveGovernorContract(inputs) {
115   const src = inputs && typeof inputs === 'object' && !Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : {};
116   const prereg = src.preregThresholds && typeof src.preregThresholds === 'object'
117     ? src.preregThresholds
118     : {};
119   const locked = lockGovernorOutput({ ...src, ...prereg });
120   const tier = resolveTier(src.stakes ?? src.stakesTier ?? {});
121   return { ...locked, tier };
122 }
